stances_toward.note: Kenya is the cooperative neighbour on the southern flank: Ethiopia committed to the Lamu port and the LAPSSET corridor in 2023, President Ruto announced in Feb 2025 that Ethiopia would move imports through Lamu, and Kenya carries Ethiopian power to Tanzania. Not an alliance: Lamu's share of Ethiopian freight is marginal and no 2026 Ruto-Abiy agreement was found. Bond none; interest only.

stances_toward.note: Partner with friction. Kenya is an AUSSOM contributor and the two presidents endorsed the new mission in a warm joint statement in October 2024; Hassan Sheikh met Ruto again in June 2026 over AUSSOM funding, and Ruto raised questions about the status of Somalia's federal institutions. The friction is structural: Nairobi has backed Jubaland's Madobe for over a decade and quietly disapproved of the federal plan for a parallel Gedo administration, Jubaland fighters beaten at Balad Hawo in 2025 fled to Mandera and Jubaland troops were again reported there in 2026 (Mogadishu has accused Kenya of arming militias; Kenya denies it), and Kenya rejected the ICJ's October 2021 maritime ruling 'in totality' after withdrawing from the case. Cooling because the 2026 constitutional crisis puts Madobe's cause and Nairobi's against Villa Somalia. Bond grievance: the unimplemented maritime ruling and the Jubaland buffer.

The grade partner is transactional cooperation without alignment. Bond none is our reading. Kenya trade figures and Kiir family interests in Kenya are not researched (gap).

stances_toward.note: Reluctant partner, cooling: our reading (confidence C), no source uses the word. Tanzania stays in the East African Community and the bilateral trade talks but resists the common-market commitments. The Regional Monitoring Committee blames it for 39% of EAC trade barriers; Kenya objected in July 2025 to a Tanzanian law on non-citizens and to price rises of up to 65% on some products; a Tanzanian levy on Kenyan matchboxes was reported in May 2026 despite an East African Court of Justice suspension; the 30 June 2026 NTB deadline lapsed with little progress. Bond none: pure trade interest, no kinship or grievance in the sources.
